legend: In this series of images, we demonstrate a ROSE procedure during an ultrasound-guided FNAB in a child with an intra-abdominal mass. The clinical suspicions were Burkitt lymphoma, neuroblastoma, or even rhabdomyosarcoma. The biopsy was performed in the operating room with the child under anaesthesia (A,B). In an adjoining room, a cytotechnician (C) and the pathologist (D) wait for the material to be processed and analysed by ROSE. In this case, the ROSE diagnosis was that of neuroblastoma (E). A CNB (F) was immediately performed to obtain an additional sample for ancillary techniques, a central venous catheter was placed for chemotherapy, and a bone marrow collection was performed for staging.
